items.title: Periodic trends in atomic radius (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Periodic trends in atomic radius: a main subheading of 1.7.1 Variation in atomic radius, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 7-8.

blocks.text: Atomic radius par asar dalne wale factors yeh hain: atomic number, effective nuclear charge (nucleus ki asal attraction (kashish) jo bahar ke electron mehsoos karte hain) aur andar wale electrons ka shielding effect. Aam taur par period mein baen se daen atomic radius kam hota hai, kyun ke nuclear charge barhta hai aur electron cloud ko qareeb kheench leta hai. Is ke ulat group mein oopar se neeche atomic radius barhta hai, kyun ke naye electron shells jurte hain; zyada shielding atom ko bara kar deti hai, halan ke nuclear charge bhi barhta hai, magar shells ka asar zyada hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Sodium ka atom magnesium se bara kyun hai, lekin potassium se chhota kyun?
blocks.explanation: Magnesium usi period mein sodium ke baad hai: ek extra proton usi bahar wale shell ko qareeb kheenchta hai, is liye magnesium chhota hai. Potassium usi group mein sodium ke neeche hai: us ka ek extra shell hai aur andar ke electrons ki shielding barhe hue nuclear charge par bhari hai, is liye potassium bara hai.

items: Atomic radius: do jure hue ek jaise atoms ke fasle ka aadha, pm ya Å mein; bond ki type aur atom ki state par depend.
Period mein baen se daen kam (zyada nuclear charge, wohi shell); group mein neeche zyada (zyada shells, zyada shielding).
